findings.what: All three reaction schemes (the aniline nitration product mixture, the acetanilide protection/nitration/hydrolysis sequence, and the sulphonation sequence) are set as reduced bitmap panels inside a thin ruled box and flush left in the text column. The book prints them unframed, centred and about twice the size. The compound captions -- 'Acetanilide', 'p-Nitroacetanilide', 'p-Nitroaniline', 'Anilinium hydrogensulphate', 'Sulphanilic acid', 'Zwitter ion' -- drop to roughly half body-text size as a result.
findings.where: the three reaction figures under the Nitration and Sulphonation headings

findings.what: Each figure box butts straight against the line of text above it with no space, so the nitration figure opens immediately below 'rivative is also formed.' and the acetanilide figure immediately below 'can be obtained as the major product.' The book leaves a clear band of white above and below each scheme.
findings.where: above each of the three reaction figures

note: Compared block by block, with all three figures checked at magnification. Every structure is complete and nothing is clipped at a panel edge: the nitration figure keeps the para, meta and ortho nitroanilines with their NO2 groups and the yields (51%), (47%) and (2%); the acetylation sequence keeps all four structures with (CH3CO)2O/Pyridine, HNO3, H2SO4, 288K and 'OH- or H+' over the arrows plus all three captions; the sulphonation figure keeps aniline, the anilinium hydrogensulphate with its + and - charges, sulphanilic acid with SO3H, the equilibrium arrows and the zwitter ion with +NH3 and SO3-. Magenta colour coding survives inside the figures. All running text is present and complete, with the meta/ortho/para italics and the bold italic '(b) Nitration' and '(c) Sulphonation' heads retained, and the folio 273 with the 'Amines' running foot is present. The blank lower third is the page ending early after reflow.
